title: ELITS Website: WEBFEST Winning Entry
subtitle: A winning static website for a CvSU student organization
description: The ELITS website was created for WEBFEST, a school competition that challenged participants to design and develop a static website for a student organization. Our entry represented the Elite League of Information Technology Students at CvSU Main Campus and won the competition.

overview.challenge: WEBFEST tasked participants with creating a static website that could clearly represent a student organization, communicate its identity, and organize its information into an engaging browsing experience without using a backend.
overview.solution: We created a multi-page static website for ELITS using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap. The design applies the organization's orange-and-dark visual identity across a promotional homepage, membership showcase, and organization profile. The completed entry won the WEBFEST competition.

contributors.name: Joseph Bataller
contributors.imageAlt: Joseph Bataller wearing a black graduation robe
contributions: Helped translate the ELITS identity into a consistent orange, dark, and white visual direction for the competition entry.
Built static page layouts and navigation using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap.
Developed the homepage presentation with organization messaging, calls to action, and content discovery sections.
Created the static membership showcase for presenting available packages, inclusions, and organization merchandise.
Developed the organization profile experience to introduce ELITS and present its officers and identity.
Refined the entry's visual hierarchy, spacing, reusable styling, and cross-page consistency for the final WEBFEST presentation.

modules.title: Organization Homepage
modules.description: A branded landing experience that introduces ELITS, promotes membership, and gives visitors clear paths to explore the student organization and its content.

modules.title: Membership Showcase
modules.description: A static promotional page that presents ELITS membership options, benefits, package inclusions, and merchandise through visually distinct sections.

modules.title: Who We Are
modules.description: An organization profile that communicates the purpose of ELITS and introduces the people representing the student organization.
